title: Golem
wikitext:
{{For|the creature type|Golem (monster type)}} '''Golems''' are a type of [[minion]]. [[Transfigured gem|Non-transfigured]] versions of golems provide a [[buff]] to its owner while alive (exception: Summon Carrion Golem); multiple copies of the same golem will not stack the buffs. A player can have a maximum of one active Golem by default. ==List of golem skill gems== {{Drop enabled gem table |where=items.name LIKE "%Golem%" }} ==Golem limit== The maximum number of active golems can be increased with the following: {| class="wikitable" ! Name ! Additional Golems |- | "of Hordes" [[transfigured gem]]s | +2 |- | Notable passive {{psl|Golem Commander}} | +1 |- | [[Ascendant]] notable passive {{psl|id=AscendancyAscendant38}} | +1 |- | [[Elementalist]] notable passive {{psl|Liege of the Primordial}} | +2 |- | {{il|Clayshaper}} | +1, or +2 if dual-wielded |- | [[Foulborn unique item|Foulborn]] {{il|Midnight Bargain}} | +2, or +4 if dual-wielded |- | {{il|The Anima Stone}} | +1 if equipping or socketing three or more Primordial items |- | {{il|The Primordial Chain}} | +3, or +4 if corrupted with {{il|Volatile Vaal Orb}} |- | {{il|Congregation Support}} | +48% for gem level 7 for an [[Elementalist]] or +50% for gem level 8 for an [[Ascendant]]/other classes (e.g. socketed into corrupted {{il|Dialla's Malefaction}}) |- | {{il|The Dark Monarch}} with {{c|mod|Maximum number of Golems is Doubled}} | x2 |} This allows for a theoretical maximum of 44 golems as an [[Elementalist]], 42 golems as an [[Ascendant]] and 38 golems as every other remaining class.
